response.overview: Thoughts Of Life is a feeling and emotionally-driven film about a 13-year-old girl diagnosed with Common Variable Immune Deficiency (CVID) who is consumed by the fear of death and the uncertainty of the afterlife. Her mother (played by Bussakorn Wongpuapan), desperate to ease her daughter’s anxieties, tries to provide reassurance and comfort, even while grappling with her fears. The film explores their everyday relationship, revealing the fragility of life and strength in love.
response.title: Thoughts of Life
